summary: @onereach/si-list preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package advertises itself as a Vue list-input component but its preinstall hook runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases into a temp directory, marks it executable, and uses it to execute the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727 KB Bun-cjs bundle with heavy obfuscation — string-array rotation via a WV8StW shift routine and hex-named identifiers — that cannot be statically audited. Fetching an alternate language runtime at install time solely to execute an opaque bundled payload is unrelated to the declared Vue component functionality; the effect is arbitrary code execution on the installer's host during npm install, bypassing Node-based install-time inspection.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
